policy: No gate passes automatically from a successful workflow alone.

required_evidence: Automated tests and reproducible execution instructions
review_checks: Confirm the harness runs from a clean checkout
Confirm input and output schemas reject invalid data
Confirm expected outcomes are independently specified
Confirm the pilot validates apparatus only, not agent performance

required_evidence: Adversarial test source and successful run
Test output covering declared adversarial cases
review_checks: Confirm each declared adversarial case is exercised
Confirm failures are detected rather than silently accepted
Confirm identical inputs and configurations are compared
Confirm relevant outputs are invariant across repeated runs
Confirm verifier evidence is not merely the agent's self-report
Document any remaining shared dependencies or trust assumptions
Confirm floor and ceiling cases are distinguishable
Confirm scoring can detect uninformative or saturated behavior

required_evidence: Label audit fixture and test output
review_checks: Confirm deliberately incorrect labels are detected
Confirm passing synthetic cases is not treated as real-world validation

required_evidence: Leakage audit source and run output
review_checks: Confirm checks cover the declared leakage paths
Document that structural checks do not prove all leakage is absent

required_evidence: Metric recalculation and reproducibility workflow runs
review_checks: Recalculate metrics from raw counts
Check denominator rules and undefined rates
Check confidence intervals and effect calculations where applicable
Confirm correction and authorization rules are tested
Confirm blocked unauthorized actions are distinguished from attempted actions

required_evidence: Held-out VFL test source and run output
review_checks: Confirm held-out cases are not used for feedback or tuning
Confirm feedback is based on verified failures
Treat hardcoded synthetic outcomes as apparatus tests, not real learning evidence

required_evidence: Task, ground-truth, hidden-test and scoring-predicate hashes
review_checks: Confirm benchmark content is complete and versioned
Confirm task semantics and scoring rules are fixed before evaluation

required_evidence: System versions, exactly 10 seeds, environment and execution limits
Network policy and statistical analysis configuration
review_checks: Confirm evaluation settings are fixed before scored runs
Confirm configuration is separate from the content freeze
